meta.guardrail_pack: GCC Perishable & Cold-Storage Guardrails for AI Agents
meta.precedence: This overlay takes precedence over the base file on any conflict. Base rules GCC-EDGE-001..020 and GCC-NORM-001..005 remain in force unless explicitly overridden here.
meta.primary_competent_authority: Ministry of Public Health - Food Safety Department

derived_from.worked_vertical: finfish_seafood (chilled), extended to all chilled 0-5 C and frozen <= -18 C perishables

meta.disclaimer: Operational guardrails for agent design. Not legal advice. Penalty figures and procedures change; verify at source before enforcement.

rules.title: Multi-agency notification - MOPH is not the only addressee

legal_basis.instrument: Law No. 8 of 1990 on the Regulation of Human Food Control, Article 7 (competent authorities and their respective jurisdictions), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2014
legal_basis.authority: Ministry of Public Health Food Safety Department, with the Ministry of Municipality, MOCI, the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change, HMC and PHCC

agent_must: Identify every authority with jurisdiction over the specific leg before proposing a notification path - Qatar operates a multi-agency model and Article 7 allocates jurisdiction
Route foodborne illness signals to MOPH and note the HMC/PHCC surveillance interface
Draft, escalate, and let a named human transmit
agent_must_not: Assume MOPH notification alone discharges every duty
Notify a single authority by default because it was correct on a previous consignment
rules.escalation: Immediate human escalation with the jurisdiction map attached.

rules.title: QS 10050:2025 governs shelf life - do not apply pre-2025 assumptions

legal_basis.instrument: Ministerial Decision No. 102 of 2025 adopting Qatari Technical Regulation QS 10050:2025 on the Shelf Life of Food Products, developed by MOCI with MOPH, the Ministry of Municipality and QS; published December 2025

trigger.expression: shelf life, expiry or remaining-life question arises for a Qatari consignment

agent_must: Apply QS 10050:2025 as the governing shelf-life instrument and cite it explicitly
Flag that any shelf-life logic derived from a pre-2025 code of practice or guidance document is superseded
Confirm transition and phase-in dates with MOCI or QS before applying it to in-transit stock
Report excursion-consumed shelf life separately from the printed date
agent_must_not: Apply shelf-life reasoning taken from the 2020 MOPH Food Safety Code of Practice without checking it against QS 10050:2025
Assume the GCC half-life-on-arrival convention without confirming the figure under QS 10050:2025
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa where the applicable shelf-life rule cannot be confirmed.

rules.title: Penalty amounts are unverified - never state a figure

legal_basis.instrument: Law No. 8 of 1990, Chapter on Crimes and Penalties, Articles 19-23, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2014

trigger.expression: agent is asked to state Qatari penalty exposure

agent_must: State that the specific fine and imprisonment ranges under Articles 19-23 as amended are not verified in the sibling country profile and must be read from Al Meezan
Describe the enforcement measures available (prohibition of handling, seizure, withdrawal, destruction, closure, fines, imprisonment) without quoting amounts
Escalate any release-against-proposal to a named human
agent_must_not: Invent, estimate or infer a Qatari fine figure
Transfer a UAE or Kuwaiti figure by analogy
rules.note: This is a deliberate known-gap rule. The sibling Qatar profile marks penalty amounts as NOT STATED because Al Meezan is JavaScript-rendered and no machine-readable official text was retrievable.

rules.title: No re-dating; allergen menu disclosure survives substitution

legal_basis.instrument: GSO 9 date marking as adopted (producer-applied indelible dates, no stickers, one date per pack); MOPH Food Safety Code of Practice for Food Services requires menu items to declare the presence of GSO 9 allergens

trigger.expression: proposal to alter a date or label after an excursion, OR a salvage substitution changes the ingredient profile of a food service item

agent_must: Refuse date and label alteration including shortening
Flag that a substitution made during salvage can invalidate the menu allergen declaration for a food service destination
Re-verify the allergen declaration whenever an ingredient is substituted
agent_must_not: Assume the menu allergen declaration is unaffected by a substitution

rules.title: Halal segregation during emergency transfer

legal_basis.instrument: Adopted GSO 2055-1; halal slaughter certificate required for meat and poultry, halal certificate for products with halal-relevant ingredients
legal_basis.authority: MOPH with the Ministry of Municipality

trigger.expression: emergency transfer, co-storage or cross-dock on a halal-relevant consignment

agent_must: Verify prior-load history and segregation of any substitute unit
Treat halal integrity as a separate pass/fail dimension
Record the halal certificate reference alongside the transfer decision
agent_must_not: Optimise only for temperature when selecting a substitute unit
Treat temperature recovery as curing a segregation break
rules.escalation: reject the halal claim and escalate.

rules.title: Cold-chain failure at a food service destination reopens the prerequisite programme

legal_basis.instrument: MOPH Food Safety Code of Practice for Food Services (Rev. 0, October 2020), Part A prerequisite programmes - including ambient temperature, air quality and ventilation, and documents and records

trigger.expression: excursion occurs at or on delivery to a food service establishment
signals: receiving dock delay in high ambient

agent_must: Check whether the excursion indicates a prerequisite programme failure at the receiving establishment, not just a transport failure
Require the establishment's documents and records for the relevant prerequisite area
Recognise that MOPH inspection covers restaurants, hotels, supermarkets and food factories - the receiving site is in scope, not only the carrier
agent_must_not: Attribute a receiving-site failure to the carrier by default
Close a case on the transport leg when the excursion pattern points to the destination chiller
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa and open a prerequisite programme review at the receiving site.

rules.title: Authority names in older Qatari guidance are outdated

legal_basis.instrument: Institutional renaming since Law No. 4 of 2014

trigger.expression: agent cites a Qatari authority or an older guidance document

agent_must: Use Ministry of Public Health, not Supreme Council of Health
Use Ministry of Municipality, not Ministry of Municipality and Urban Planning
Note that several GSO editions cited in the 2020 code of practice are dated (GSO 21/1984, 323/1994, 969/1997, 1694/2005, 1909/2009, 1971/2009, 2309/2013) and verify current editions
agent_must_not: Reproduce superseded authority names from a source document without correction

rules.title: Arabic operator narrative parsing

legal_basis.instrument: Adopted GSO 9 Arabic labelling requirement; bilingual operations

trigger.expression: artifact language is ar_msa OR mixed

agent_must: Parse °م as Celsius preserving exact values
Apply base rules GCC-EDGE-008 and GCC-EDGE-011 to Arabic hedge words
Convert any Hijri date to Gregorian and show both
Quote the Arabic verbatim in evidence
agent_must_not: Take the midpoint of an approximate range
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa where translation ambiguity changes the disposition.

rules.title: Normal Qatari clearance path

trigger.expression: base GCC-NORM-001 or GCC-NORM-002 satisfied AND shelf life confirmed under QS 10050:2025 AND halal documentation complete

agent_must: Confirm the MOPH health control gate and any Ministry of Municipality quarantine gate separately
Cite Law No. 8 of 1990 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2014, and QS 10050:2025 where shelf life is material
agent_must_not: Report clearance without naming which authority cleared which aspect

rules.title: Qatari record and citation contract
agent_must: Cite the specific article or technical regulation relied on
Record the inspection reference and retain the raw telemetry artifact unmodified
agent_must_not: Quote a penalty figure - see QA-EDGE-003
